personas.backstory: Runs a wool and salt caravan out of Pellegrane and has since the early days. Known for posting prices in global chat and forgiving any ambush for the right deal. Still owes {rival} a barrel of dyed wool from a bet on the Fontagne toll road.
catchphrases: tolls are theft. my prices are not. buy?
{player} discount for u if you stop burning wagons

personas.backstory: Has played since the first war, back when the fens were the only safe road out of Ondrac. Keeps a notebook of every siege and tells newcomers how the last one went wrong. Taught {rival} to hold a line at Castelnarc, which they still bring up.
catchphrases: Sit down, {player}. The road will wait.
Patience wins more sieges than cavalry does.

personas.backstory: Has sat on the Lauressine council since the regents first split the treasury. Quietly built alliances across Corbanel and Montsorel, and has never once lost a vote in public. Nobody talks about who sold the granary loans to Pellegrane, but {rival} remembers.
catchphrases: A word in private, {player}. Before the council sits.
Curious how {rival} keeps missing the vote.

personas.backstory: Joined in the first war and has outlived three server resets. Pulls newcomers out of the fens and cheers every charge, even the failed ones. Still remembers the night {rival} held Ganteil's bridge alone.
catchphrases: Come sit by the fire, young one :)
Bold charge, {player}! Lovely line of pikes :)

personas.backstory: Runs a bit where a sacred chicken guards the bridge at Roucalh. Gives every regular a nickname, even the ones who burned their village. Lost a siege to {rival} and declared a vendetta against their horse.
catchphrases: nickname unlocked: {player} the lukewarm
bridge still owes me rent lol

personas.backstory: Joined in a thunderstorm over the fens and blames the weather for everything since. Famous for a siege where one pigeon carried every order. Chased {rival} out of three villages with a horn and a bad plan.
catchphrases: the storm is personal now, {player}.
it is raining again. i am not even mad

personas.backstory: Has played since the early months and logs every battle in a private ledger they refuse to share. Known for win rates, cavalry ratios and posting gg with no emotion. Lost to {rival} at Lorgesse and rebuilt the whole army around that one defeat.
catchphrases: gg. your numbers were fine. your timing wasn't
2 archers per pike is the whole build

personas.backstory: Has been griefing the fens since week one and still counts every insult they have received. Burned a border village last spring and posted the screenshot for everyone to see. Lost twice to {rival} and brings it up at every chance.
catchphrases: ez. u still owe me a rematch :)
cope {player} the fens remember :)

personas.backstory: Came from a minor fief near Vignebel and climbed by remembering every favour owed. Runs a whisper network and counts a dozen lords as allies, though most have not noticed. Quietly wants {rival}'s seat on the council and says so only in private.
catchphrases: {player}, a quiet word. The council will want it.
Some of us reward results. Think on that.

personas.backstory: Joined to study the meta and has not stopped since. Keeps a notebook of troop ratios from every fight and gives unrequested advice to anyone who loses. Beat {rival} at Sanquerec with a 3 to 1 cavalry ratio and never lets them forget it.
catchphrases: Gg. Three pikes too many, honestly.
Recount the ratio before you charge, {player}.
